title: Scout C-C: routing and handoff economics plus a token baseline from the run logs (P14-P16, P29, P1 baseline)
spec: Objective: give the Planner the current routing and handoff mechanics with anchors, and a measured baseline of tokens per role and per accepted task from the run logs. Read (this checkout, main): orchestrator/executor.py (pick_executor inputs, resume_plan fresh vs resume, MAX_ROUNDS, fix-delta packet), orchestrator/pool.py (pick order, cooldowns, budgets, planner account pick), orchestrator/planner_router.py and orchestrator/planner_runs.py (Opus default, Fable escalation tier, escalation triggers, what the escalation launch receives), orchestrator/planner_packet.py, orchestrator/planner_shadow.py, orchestrator/handover.py, orchestrator/daemon.py auto_fix_round and _fix_round_spec, orchestrator/scorecard.py and orchestrator/attribution.py (fields, by_task, by_goal, routing_eval), orchestrator/bus.py log_run (the run-log line schema). Then compute from .orchestrator/runs/2026-09-2*.jsonl (worker runs; use jq or python, read-only) and .orchestrator/runs/jev/*.jsonl: per role (execute, review, spec_review, scout, challenge, planner) count of runs, mean and p90 input tokens, output tokens, cache-read tokens, cost where present; per accepted execute task the total tokens across its execute + fix rounds + reviews + spec reviews (join on task id and lineage if the log carries it, else approximate by task id prefix) for the last three days; share of tokens spent in fix rounds; count of planner launches by model and escalations; Jev daily tokens. Deliver: 1. the baseline table (state exactly which log fields you used and any approximation); 2. anchors for where a handoff rebuilds context (escalation packet, fresh fix round, Codex fresh thread) and what it re-sends; 3. the inputs pick_executor and the planner router use today and where a handoff-cost term would enter; 4. which scorecard/attribution fields could carry handoff cost and duplicated-context estimates without a schema change. Rules: read-only; cite path:line; confidence per finding; result under 1,500 tokens; do not print raw log lines; unverifiable stated as such.
acceptance: result under 1,500 tokens with a baseline table naming its log fields, and anchored findings with confidence
every deliverable item answered or marked unverifiable

constraints.objective: routing handoff economics and token baseline

findings.claim: Baseline uses .orchestrator/runs/2026-09-{20,21,22}.jsonl fields: role, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, usd, task; jev uses .orchestrator/runs/jev/2026-09-{19..22}.jsonl fields input_tokens only (no output/cache logged there)
execute: n=155, mean_in=963995 p90_in=1776991, mean_out=7471 p90_out=11334, mean_cache_read=909139, mean_usd=6.9071 (75/155 rows have usd; Codex rows often log none)

review: n=127, mean_in=23 p90_in=32, mean_out=14298 p90_out=22105, mean_cache_read=658015, mean_usd=0.4577 (127/127 have usd) -- low input_tokens is the non-cached remainder, bulk sits in cache_read (near-fully cached packets)
spec_review: n=60, mean_in=27 p90_in=42, mean_out=15399 p90_out=22471, mean_cache_read=858581, mean_usd=0.5706 (59/60 have usd)
scout: n=9, mean_in=37 p90_in=64, mean_out=13484 p90_out=18538, mean_cache_read=1285103, mean_usd=0.8077 (9/9 have usd)
memory n=73, jev_route n=48, scout_decision n=3 log zero token/usd fields this period (fields absent, not zero-cost) -- treat as unmeasured, not free

No 'planner' or 'challenge' role rows in runs/2026-09-20..22.jsonl, and .orchestrator/runs/planner_runs.json (the file scorecard._planner_runs_for_goal expects) does not exist -- planner launch count by model and escalation count are UNVERIFIABLE for this window

Per accepted execute task, last 3 days: 77 accepted-task roots (merged_into set) had run activity ts>=2026-09-20T00:00Z; mean total tokens/task=3730653, median=2442871, min=285919, max=32303564. APPROXIMATION: root found by walking constraints.fix_round_for on tasks/T-*.json (reimplements attribution.lineage since older run rows lack lineage_root); token=input+output+cache_read summed over every row whose task equals the root or a fix-round descendant

Fix-round share of tokens = tokens on execute rows whose task has constraints.fix_round_for or auto_round, divided by tokens on all rows carrying a task field, 3-day window = 87356685/441781823 = 19.8%. APPROXIMATION: excludes review/spec_review re-passes spent on fix rounds (undercounts true fix-loop cost); token measure = input+output+cache_read per scorecard._tokens_of convention
Fresh fix round (no codex_thread, MAX_ROUNDS=5 exhausted, or incompatible worktree) resends the full task briefing via spawn.packet()+repair delta -- the expensive handoff path
Normal resume sends only ['resume', codex_thread, delta] -- reuses Codex's own thread state, no repacket, cheapest path

Escalation packet (Opus->Fable) resends only a filtered slice: goal, filtered original_sections, whitelisted opus_decision (400/800-char caps, max 10 tasks), unresolved, conflicting_evidence, scout_findings, memory_hits, capped at 6000 chars -- smaller than a fresh fix round but a real second context build

Planner session handover rewrites plan.md's Auto-handover section every ~15min (matches daemon interval), capped at 120 lines, items below p_relevant 0.5 pruned except merged/held -- a fresh Planner session re-reads this capped snapshot, not full task history

open_questions: planner launch count by model and escalation count: no planner/challenge role rows and no planner_runs.json in this window -- needs either a longer window or confirmation the file was ever populated

per-task total-token join used a reimplemented lineage walk over tasks/T-*.json rather than the shipped lineage_root field, since older run rows predate that field -- worth re-running once all rows in the window post-date it for an exact figure
suggested_next: if exact planner-launch/escalation counts are needed, check whether an older planner_runs.json exists in state history or whether that logging path is currently dead code
add lineage_root-based grouping to scorecard.by_task as the concrete handoff-cost/duplicated-context metric, reusing existing fields per findings above
